about_the_game:
Draw Sword — Wield your pen to carve the path to victory!

Draw Sword is a creative physics-based drawing combat game where your true weapon isn’t just a sword — it’s the line you draw!

Control a charming stickman warrior by sketching movement paths, and engage in unpredictable duels against opponents following their own pre-set trajectories.

🖍️ Draw your path, strike with strategy

You don’t control your character directly. Instead, you draw a path in advance. Your character will follow the line you created, attacking along the way. Every trajectory becomes a tactical decision.

⚔️ Challenge intelligent opponents

Each enemy moves along a pre-drawn path. Anticipate their movements and design your counterattack with precision — outsmart them with the stroke of your pen!

🎮 Easy to pick up, hard to master

With simple, intuitive controls, you’ll be drawing and battling in seconds. But to truly master the timing and angle of each strike takes clever planning and practice.

🎨 Physics chaos and comic clashes

Powered by a physics engine, each battle brings unexpected and often hilarious interactions. Swords fly, stickmen tumble, and laughter ensues in every duel.
